name: Auth0
description: Auth0 is an authentication and authorization platform (an Okta product) that the vendor describes as "an easy to implement, adaptable authentication and authorization platform" for integrating identity into applications.
best_for: Serves developers building consumer apps, internal tools, and enterprise software, plus startups, enterprises needing SSO/SCIM/multi-tenancy, and B2B/B2C SaaS companies.

tiers.name: Free (B2C)
tiers.notes: Includes 1 enterprise connection, SCIM (inbound), passkeys, unlimited social connections. Log retention is only 1 day; Management API is capped at 2 req/sec for free tenants.

tiers.name: Essentials (B2C)
tiers.unit: starts at 500 MAU, scales to $3,500/mo at 50,000 MAU
tiers.notes: Annual billing works out to 11x the monthly rate (one month free) but is not required. Log retention is 5 days.

tiers.name: Professional (B2C)
tiers.unit: starts at 500 MAU, up to $3,200/mo at 20,000 MAU
tiers.notes: Log retention is 10 days. Adds enhanced attack protection, custom database connections, and cross-app SSO.

tiers.name: Essentials (B2B)
tiers.unit: starts at 500 MAU, up to $3,800/mo at 20,000 MAU
tiers.notes: Includes 3 enterprise connections; additional connections are $100/mo each.

tiers.name: Professional (B2B)
tiers.unit: starts at 500 MAU, up to $2,400/mo at 10,000 MAU
tiers.notes: Includes 5 enterprise connections; additional connections are $100/mo each.

tiers.name: Enterprise (B2C & B2B)
tiers.notes: Contact sales. Only tier with a 99.99% SLA, private deployment, 30-day log retention, and HIPAA/BAA compliance.

cons: Log retention scales tightly with tier: 1 day on Free, 5 days on Essentials, 10 days on Professional, and 30 days only on the custom-quoted Enterprise plan — thin history for incident investigation without paying for Enterprise.

B2B pricing is dramatically higher than B2C at the same tier name and monthly-active-user count: Essentials is $35/mo (B2C) versus $150/mo (B2B), and Professional is $240/mo (B2C) versus $800/mo (B2B).

Additional enterprise SSO connections beyond a plan's included count cost $100/month each on B2B Essentials and Professional, and the free tier's Management API is capped at 2 requests/second, which can bottleneck automated provisioning during evaluation.
features: Auth0 for AI Agents (async authorization, RAG pipeline controls)

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: Auth0's parent-company workforce identity platform, providing SSO and adaptive MFA for employees/partners across 8,000+ integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises managing internal workforce access rather than embedding customer-facing auth into an app.

alternatives.name: 1Password
alternatives.description: Provides a credential vault and secrets management platform rather than a developer authentication API.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing a shared vault for passwords/secrets rather than building login flows into their own product.
